Frequently Asked Questions
What is the H-1B visa, and what are its main limitations?
The H-1B visa allows U.S. companies to hire skilled foreign professionals in areas like IT, AI, data engineering, and software development. However, it has strict annual caps (85,000 visas), long approval timelines, and now a $100,000 supplemental fee (2025) for new petitions. These factors make hiring through H-1B costly, unpredictable, and unsustainable for many growing tech companies.
In 2025, what are the best ways for U.S. companies to hire skilled developers without going through the H-1B visa process?
The most effective alternatives are Offshore Development Centers (ODCs) and Managed Remote Teams in talent-rich regions like India. These models let U.S. companies build reliable, full-time engineering teams abroad without visa hassles while maintaining continuous project delivery.
What is an Offshore Development Center (ODC), and how does it work?
An Offshore Development Center (ODC) is a dedicated extension of your in-house team based overseas. Managed by a partner like SculptSoft, it includes full-time engineers, infrastructure, HR, and compliance support giving you long-term control, IP protection, and scalability while cutting operational costs.
Why should U.S. companies partner with SculptSoft for offshore hiring?
SculptSoft helps U.S. businesses build secure, high-performance engineering teams in India without visa delays. As an AWS Select Tier Partner with 12+ years of expertise in AI, cloud, and data engineering, SculptSoft offers cost-efficient, compliant, and scalable offshore solutions tailored for startups, SMBs, and enterprises.
What are the risks of hiring offshore developers, and how can they be mitigated?
The main risks are data security, communication gaps, and cultural alignment. These are mitigated by working with certified partners like SculptSoft, which ensures ISO 27001-based security, NDA/IP protection, dedicated project managers, and overlapping U.S. time zones.
